svg.title: JAR7: the ages of one speleothem under each age model
svg.text: Each line is the age one model gives to every sample of the speleothem (geolod:AgeAssignment, one per model and sample).
depth from the top of the speleothem (mm)
Not every model reaches every sample; the second figure number is the count of samples of the speleothem. 1 depth carries two dating points more than 0.5 ka apart (1106.9 mm).
